label: VEX Statement Generator
description: Generate a machine-readable OpenVEX statement when a Dependabot alert is dismissed with a security justification
tips: Pass the dismissed Dependabot alert's fields (alert number, GHSA/CVE id, package, ecosystem, severity, dismissal reason) as typed workflow_dispatch inputs rather than having the agent search for them

Map the Dependabot dismissal reason to an OpenVEX status and justification: not_used -> not_affected / vulnerable_code_not_present, inaccurate -> not_affected / vulnerable_code_not_in_execute_path, tolerable_risk -> not_affected / inline_mitigations_already_exist
Skip generating a statement when the dismissal reason is no_bandwidth, since that dismissal is not a security assessment
Write each statement to .vex/<ghsa-id>.json as a standalone OpenVEX v0.2.0 document so it stays independently readable by downstream scanners
Construct the package URL (purl) from the repository's own manifest version, not the dismissed alert's vulnerable version range
Open the result as a pull request rather than committing directly, so a maintainer reviews the generated VEX statement and impact wording before it is published
